lessons: False premise: the ticket says FakeExec is the provider-script variant from test_providers.py and must be re-exported only if tests.fakes.FakeExec already does what it does. It does not, so move class FakeExec from test_providers.py:67 into tests/config_helpers.py unchanged.

The provider-script FakeExec (test_providers.py:67-94) is already in-memory: scripted responses, on_spawn/on_stdout_line callbacks, calls dicts, hang Event, kill_group. It runs no process, so moving it breaks no I/O rule and does not duplicate the shared fake. Do not edit tests/fakes.py.

Leave PythonProviderExec and python_client in test_providers.py. In test_watchdog.py and test_watchdog_activation.py, keep only the hub import lines named in criterion 2. Move every other listed name into tests/config_helpers.py; hubs import them back.

provider_session uses a real Journal under cfg.state_dir. Keep its signature and, in unit tests, point state_dir at tmp_path, or use tests.fakes.FakeJournal if callers allow it. watch_fixture_repo must not run git; it stores a GitFake in WATCH_GIT.
Record unit and integration passed/skipped counts for base and candidate in run.md (criterion 5). Check criteria 2-4 with the exact grep commands from the ticket before finishing.
